dropped.finding: The two hashing sites resolve their basis through different code paths that only coincide by runtime convention: the signing / drift-refresh path (`_rehash` -> `_hash_basis(repo_root)`) resolves to `current_code_root()`/working tree, while the claim gate uses `_hash_basis(repo_root, at_current_gate_ref=True)` (the gate-ref snapshot). They match only because `drift_refresh` runs inside an attested `review_plan` where `current_code_root()` is set to the gate-ref snapshot; nothing structurally enforces that invariant, so a future caller of `_rehash` outside a gate session could silently compare against a different basis than the claim gate.
